disease_label_per_paper: Non-typhoidal Salmonella group D bacteremia and urosepsis in a patient diagnosed with HIV infection
presentation_summary: 52-year-old man admitted to ICU with high-grade fever, shortness of breath, hypotension, and urosepsis after weeks of poor oral intake and weight loss.
He had no cough, expectoration, nausea, vomiting, dysuria, bleeding, loose bowel movements, or altered mental status.
Physical exam showed moderate distress, temperature 38.1 degC, blood pressure 100/50 mmHg, and decreased breath sounds bilaterally.
Serial blood and urine cultures grew non-typhoidal Salmonella Group D; subsequent work-up found advanced HIV with CD4 count 11.
